query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Audit website search and traffic performance, prepare email marketing/contact lists, and send outreach emails for marketing and press engagement.
query_ground_truth.query: dispatch cold prospecting messages to leads
query_ground_truth.rationale: Executing the final step of marketing and press engagement involves sending outreach emails through Gmail.

request.query: dispatch cold prospecting messages to leads

results.use_case: dispatch cold prospecting messages to leads
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm campaign name, target timezone, and finalized email copy/delays before write calls using LEMLIST_POST_CREATE_CAMPAIGN/LEMLIST_POST_ADD_STEP_TO_SEQUENCE (avoid rework).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Retrieve team/workspace context using LEMLIST_GET_TEAM_INFO (select intended workspace; capture data._id as teamId).
[Optional (if avoiding duplicate names/reuse)] [Prerequisite]: Search existing campaigns using LEMLIST_GET_LIST_CAMPAIGNS (decide reuse vs create).
[Required] [Step]: Create the cold email campaign using LEMLIST_POST_CREATE_CAMPAIGN (scope to teamId; capture campaignId and sequenceId).
[Optional (if campaign settings need adjustment)] [Next Step]: Update campaign-level fields using LEMLIST_PATCH_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN (apply after creation).
[Required] [Next Step]: Add outreach emails as steps using LEMLIST_POST_ADD_STEP_TO_SEQUENCE (create sequentially with sequenceId; set type, delay, index, subject, message).
[Required] [Next Step]: Verify final step count/order and collect stepIds using LEMLIST_GET_CAMPAIGN_SEQUENCES (find steps[i]._id for the relevant sequenceId).
[Optional (if content/timing/order needs correction)] [Fallback]: Update a specific step using LEMLIST_PATCH_UPDATE_SEQUENCE_STEP (use sequenceId + verified stepId).
[Optional (if default schedule is unsuitable)] [Next Step]: Create a sending schedule using LEMLIST_POST_CREATE_SCHEDULE (ensure it matches desired hours/timezone; attach separately if needed).
[Optional (if enrolling leads programmatically)] [Next Step]: Add leads to the campaign using LEMLIST_POST_CREATE_LEAD_IN_CAMPAIGN (batch externally; retain lead IDs for dedupe).
known_pitfalls: [LEMLIST_GET_TEAM_INFO] Workspace/team ID may be returned as data._id (not teamId); choosing the wrong workspace scopes all writes incorrectly.
[LEMLIST_GET_TEAM_INFO] Can fail with 402 Payment Required (account/plan gating may block API routes).
[LEMLIST_POST_CREATE_CAMPAIGN] campaignId/sequenceId may be nested under data; parse defensively, and 402 plan-gating can occur on some accounts.
[LEMLIST_GET_CAMPAIGN_SEQUENCES] Sequences can be an object keyed by sequenceId and step IDs are in steps[i]._id; don’t assume a flat array.
[LEMLIST_POST_ADD_STEP_TO_SEQUENCE] Large delay values can trigger 500 (“Delay between the steps can’t be greater than 1500 days”); validate units/limits and retry only failed steps.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: lemlist is a prospecting tool that automates multichannel outreach, enabling users to find leads with valid contact information and reach them across email, LinkedIn, or calls with personalized messages.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=lemlist. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="lemlist") to create a connection BEFORE executing any lemlist tools.

LEMLIST_GET_TEAM_INFO.description: Tool to retrieve information about your team. Use after authentication to inspect current team settings, members, webhooks, and enabled features. Verify the returned teamId matches the intended workspace before passing it to campaign-creation or other write operations to avoid creating resources in the wrong account context.

LEMLIST_POST_CREATE_CAMPAIGN.description: Tool to create a new campaign. Use after confirming the team ID. Returns campaign, sequence, and schedule IDs nested under a `data` key (e.g., `result['data']['campaignId']`).

name.description: The name of the campaign to create

teamId.description: The ID of the team under which the campaign will be created

LEMLIST_POST_ADD_STEP_TO_SEQUENCE.description: Tool to add a new step (email, LinkedIn, conditional, etc.) to an existing sequence. Use when building or editing campaign sequences to add outreach steps.

url.description: URL of the API endpoint to call. Required for api steps. Must start with http:// or https://

type.description: The type of step to create. Must be one of: email, manual, phone, api, linkedinVisit, linkedinInvite, linkedinSend, sendToAnotherCampaign, conditional, whatsappMessage

delay.description: Delay in seconds before the step executes. Defaults to 0 for the first step, 1 for subsequent steps. For conditional steps with delayType other than 'within', delay is not required

index.description: Position in the sequence (must be >= -1). If omitted or exceeds the step count, the step is appended to the end

title.description: Title or label for manual steps. Required for manual steps

method.description: HTTP method for API steps. Required for api steps

message.description: Content for email, LinkedIn, manual, phone, or WhatsApp steps. Required for steps that send messages

subject.description: Email subject line. Required for email steps

delayType.description: Delay type for conditional steps. Must be 'within' or 'waitUntil'. For conditional steps with delayType other than 'within', the delay field is not required

examples: Alternative message if the first one fails

campaignId.description: Target campaign ID for sendToAnotherCampaign steps. Required for sendToAnotherCampaign steps

sequenceId.description: The unique identifier of the sequence to add the step to

conditionKey.description: Condition type for conditional steps. Must be one of: emailsOpened, emailsClicked, emailsUnsubscribed, meetingBooked, linkedinInviteAccepted, hasWhatsappAccount

LEMLIST_GET_LIST_CAMPAIGNS.description: Tool to retrieve a list of campaigns for the team. Use when you need to discover campaign IDs, names, or statuses before performing operations like auditing or pausing campaigns.

page.description: Page number to retrieve (alternative to offset).

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to retrieve. Default: 100, Max: 100.

offset.description: Pagination offset - number of campaigns to skip.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Currently only supports 'createdAt'.
